controls.title: No hardcoded secrets in code or versioned config
controls.objective: Verify no clear-text passwords, keys or tokens are versioned.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list files, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=app/config.py and other app/ files, and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(password|passwd|secret|api_key|token)\s*=\s*['"]. Verify secrets are loaded via os.environ, os.getenv or vault client.
controls.expected: Zero matches for hardcoded secret assignments; secrets only via vault or environment variables.
controls.risk: Hardcoded secrets enable credential theft and unauthorized access.
controls.recommendation: Remove clear-text secrets and load them from vault or environment variables.
controls.quote: Aucun secret (mot de passe, clé, jeton) n'est écrit en clair dans le code source ni dans la configuration versionnée : les secrets viennent d'un coffre ou de variables d'environnement.

controls.title: TLS certificate verification never disabled
controls.objective: Verify no outbound call disables TLS certificate verification.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=verify\s*=\s*False and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=verify\s*=\s*0. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=app/service.py to review outbound requests usage.
controls.expected: Zero matches for verify=False; all TLS calls verify certificates.
controls.recommendation: Remove verify=False and enforce TLS certificate verification.
controls.quote: Tout appel réseau sortant vérifie le certificat TLS du serveur : la vérification n'est jamais désactivée (`verify=False` interdit).

controls.title: Password hashing uses approved algorithm
controls.objective: Verify passwords are hashed only with argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=argon2|bcrypt|scrypt|pbkdf2 and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=app/auth.py to review password hashing implementation.
controls.expected: Password hashing uses only argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2.
controls.risk: Weak hashing allows password recovery after database theft.
controls.recommendation: Use argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2 for password hashing.
controls.quote: Les mots de passe sont hachés avec argon2, bcrypt, scrypt ou PBKDF2. MD5 et SHA-1 sont interdits pour tout usage de sécurité.

controls.title: MD5 and SHA-1 banned for security use
controls.objective: Verify MD5 and SHA-1 are not used for security purposes.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=\bmd5\b|\bsha1\b|hashlib\.md5|hashlib\.sha1|hashlib\.sha_1 and review matches in GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=app/auth.py.
controls.expected: Zero matches for MD5 or SHA-1 in security use.
controls.risk: MD5 and SHA-1 are collision-prone and unsuitable for security.
controls.recommendation: Remove MD5 and SHA-1 for any security use.
controls.quote: Les mots de passe sont hachés avec argon2, bcrypt, scrypt ou PBKDF2. MD5 et SHA-1 sont interdits pour tout usage de sécurité.

controls.title: CI runs static security analysis
controls.objective: Verify CI executes bandit, semgrep or CodeQL on every change.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to identify .github/workflows files, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=.github/workflows/ci.yml, and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=bandit|semgrep|CodeQL.
controls.expected: Workflow contains bandit, semgrep or CodeQL executed on every change.
controls.risk: Missing static analysis leaves vulnerabilities undetected.
controls.recommendation: Add bandit, semgrep or CodeQL to CI on every change.
controls.quote: La chaîne d'intégration continue exécute une analyse statique de sécurité (bandit, semgrep ou CodeQL) à chaque modification.

controls.title: Dependencies pinned to exact version
controls.objective: Verify all dependencies are pinned with ==.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=requirements.txt and verify each dependency line matches exact pin pattern with ==.
controls.expected: Every dependency pinned to exact version with ==.
controls.risk: Unpinned dependencies allow untested and vulnerable versions.
controls.recommendation: Pin all dependencies to exact versions with ==.
controls.quote: Les dépendances sont épinglées à une version exacte (`paquet==version`) et auditées en intégration continue (pip-audit ou équivalent).

controls.title: Dependencies audited in CI
controls.objective: Verify dependencies are audited with pip-audit or equivalent in CI.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to find workflows, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=.github/workflows/ci.yml, and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=pip-audit|pip_audit|safety|dependabot.
controls.expected: CI workflow executes pip-audit or equivalent.
controls.risk: Unaudited dependencies leave known vulnerabilities unaddressed.
controls.recommendation: Add pip-audit or equivalent audit to CI.
controls.quote: Les dépendances sont épinglées à une version exacte (`paquet==version`) et auditées en intégration continue (pip-audit ou équivalent).

controls.title: Test data declared synthetic
controls.objective: Verify test data is synthetic and flagged.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list tests/ fixtures and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q="synthetic"\s*:\s*true. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=tests/fixtures.json to confirm declaration.
controls.risk: Production data in test exposes personal and financial data.
controls.recommendation: Replace test data with synthetic data flagged synthetic true.
controls.quote: Les données de test sont synthétiques et déclarées comme telles (champ `"synthetic": true`) ; aucun export de production n'est versionné.

controls.title: No versioned production export
controls.objective: Verify no production export is versioned.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list versioned files and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=production|prod_dump|real_data|dump\.csv to detect versioned production exports.
controls.expected: Zero versioned files containing production exports.
controls.recommendation: Remove any production exports from version control.
controls.quote: Les données de test sont synthétiques et déclarées comme telles (champ `"synthetic": true`) ; aucun export de production n'est versionné.

controls.title: Authentication successes and failures logged
controls.objective: Verify application logs authentication successes and failures.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=log.*auth|auth.*log|login.*log|logger\.(info|warning|error).*auth|audit.*login and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=app/auth.py to confirm both success and failure paths log.
controls.expected: Application code logs both authentication successes and failures.
controls.risk: Missing auth logs prevents detection of brute-force attacks.
controls.recommendation: Add logging for both authentication successes and failures.
controls.quote: Les réussites et les échecs d'authentification sont journalisés par l'application.
